english.title: Make a false statement in answer to a question relating to baggage / cargo / stores on a ship
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) , in answer to a question which related to baggage, cargo or stores which were, or were intended for, carriage by sea by a

(A)_[British ship,]_
(B)_[ship to the United Kingdom,]_
(C)_[ship from the United Kingdom,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..), and was put to you for purposes to which Part III of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990 applied, by **(..SPECIFY PERSON AND THE CAPACITY IN WHICH THAT PERSON ACCORDS WITH SECTION 37(1)(b)..), made a statement which you knew to be, or recklessly made a statement which was, false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 37(1) and (4) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
